info.title: Tailchat API
info.description:
Every published Moleculer action is reachable as `POST /api/<service>/<action>` with a JSON body.
Paths below omit the `/api` prefix. The same actions are callable as socket.io events named `<service>.<action>`.

Authenticate with a user JWT in `X-Token`, or with an OpenApp API key in `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-Api-Key`.
An API key acts as the app's bot user and may only call actions permitted by its scopes (`x-tailchat-scopes` on each operation):

- `message:read`: Read messages, converses, acks and the inbox
- `message:write`: Send, recall and delete messages, react, open DMs
- `group:read`: List groups, read group info, membership and invites
- `group:manage`: Create and configure groups, panels, roles, members and invites (includes group:read)
- `user:read`: Read the bot identity, user profiles, friends and DM list
- `user:write`: Update the bot profile and settings, manage friends and DMs
- `file`: Upload and read files
- `plugins`: Call backend plugin services
- `admin`: Server administration (requires the admin app capability): find, ban and unban users, add members to any group, send system notifications

Rate limit: `API_RATE_LIMIT` requests per minute per credential (default 600), reported in `X-Rate-Limit-*` headers; HTTP 429 when exceeded.
Responses are `{ "code": <http status>, "data": <result> }`.

ApiKeyBearer.description: OpenApp API key (tck_...) from /openapi/apikey/create. Scopes listed per operation.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: OpenApp API key (tck_...), alternative to the bearer form.
